notes.title: New DLC Released! Meet... The Night Party!!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/REjgHOv.jpg

http://store.steampowered.com/app/723460

The Night Party
They met at a midnight rave party, and they soon found out they were all outcasts misunderstood by society. Yeah, like teenagers. Only they are much older. Soon they decided to band together and support each other during the long nights. And dance till dawn.

https://i.imgur.com/eIho8TH.png
David can’t control his transformation, so when playing him timing is paramount.
When in human form he’s slow and below average for a melee fighter.
But in wolf form he’s fast, deadly and mobile. His leap forward is especially effective.https://i.imgur.com/oYmhHTw.png
Donald is one of the best melee fighters in the game, fast and with good reach.
When struck, he turns into a bat and has the ability to escape and fight another time.https://i.imgur.com/WW22DVi.png
Mr. T’s first form is cumbersome, but can be effective.
However, the sarcophagus is big and an easy target.
When out of his sarcophagus, Mr. T. is a versatile long range fighter with good mobility.https://i.imgur.com/IW66H1g.png
J has a couple of options to use his potions and can play mind games with his opponents.
However, once the potion is gone, J’s options are far more limited.
When transformed, J. is a strong melee fighter who can go berserk.https://i.imgur.com/RTsDjhN.png
Zack can easily surprise the enemy by detaching his head.
While the body is headless, it can’t move, but it’s not defenseless. Plus, it can’t be hurt.
Just focus on avoiding a headshot.

notes.title: ChangeLog Version 1.02
notes.content:
This week we have been working on several aspects. Finishing some improvements that we did not have time to include in the last week patch. Some bugs that still remained in the todo list. But mainly most of our work has been getting ready the mac version. It is almost done, the game is working fine in our mac testing machines and once we have completed all the testing we will release it, hopefully along this week.

 
 Gameplay Changes  

    The BlackKnight last form has been improved. Now it has two more attacks. An air drop attack that can be performed with both action buttons while in the air. A forward attack, propelling the character forward.


 Bugs Fixed 

    There was an issue with the music playing when the game is started even when the music volume was set to 0.
   Fixed an issue the simplified chinese not displaying correctly on the codex.

notes.title: ChangeLog Version 1.01
notes.content:
It has already been a week after the launch and it is time to make some changes from the feedback we have gathered. This are the changes we have made:

 Gameplay Changes 

    Increment sacrifice time for People of the Sun. From 1.5 sec to 2.5 sec.
    Huemac superball lasts 5 seconds now. If he does not catch the ball before this time, he will have to wait 5 seconds until he recovers it.
    Allyson got her ammo reduced. From 12 to 6 bullets.
    Gun reloading time has been increased from 0.3 seconds to 0.6 seconds per bullet. This change affects Allyson and Gilly.
    Attracting Teddy bear from Ev4 cost now 1 point of energy instead of being free.
    Lia can pick up the boomerang while doing a roll when it is stucked in the floor.
    Reduced to 1 the number of Air dashes that Cuauhtli while in super.
    Added cooldown between Mike's shieldbash attack.
    Mike in super does not recover the spear after teleporting to it. The explosive teleport has a cooldown of 5 seconds without having the spear.
    All the characters got the invulnerable time after spawning reduced from 2 to 0.5 seconds.


 Bug Fixes 

    Solved an issue, causing players to join lobbies that have already started a match.
    Solved some errors in the online  synchronization that caused the game to crash or player desyncs.
    Fixed an issue causing the game to crash if it was being executed from the executable, instead of directly from steam.
    Solved a bug when using the keyboard when 4 controllers were plugged in.


More changes to come. We will do another update the next week, with more changes that did not got finished for this week update.

notes.title: Round 3 changelog
notes.content:
- We have increased the threshold for an inconsistent match, to avoid the sync error. This can lead to matches with more lag but less kicked players.
- We are improving and tweaking the interpolation system to enhance the online experience.
- We have reduced the load of packets sent through the network.
- We have added the previous two dynasties to the game, so that there are 4 dynasties playable with their corresponding level. Clan Yngling, the Cartwrongs, the Fancier's Crew and the Nekoyama-shi.
- We have reduced the number of falling spikes and increased the warning of the crying lava on the Cursed hideout level.
- Jane has been reworked. Now she can shoot in 360 degrees still and can shoot in the air too. We have added a throwable that can stun.
- Allyson now shoots two bullets instead of one.
- Raiga's dash attack now ignores armor.

notes.title: Beta Round 2 changelog
notes.content:
- Changed how the initial sincronization worked, now it should stabilized better in start of the match, and solved the problem of kicking out people right on the start.
- Fixed an error on the kicking system at the beggining of the matches, kicking withouth collecting enough data.
- Refactor the object poolsa and initialization of the objects in the scenes to improve the time of the loading screens.
- Replaced the ghosting on projectiles with trail to improve performance.
- Interpolate the projectiles and bullets, so the movement will be a lot more smoother.
- Solve several problems with the pause menu in online matches.
- Added an option for the leaderboards in the online menu.
- Added new mastered music songs.
- Bullets collision are now bigger.
- Rosemary, the archeress collision is a little bit taller. Allison's bullets should hit her now.
- Fixed an error that prevented the emotes to work properly.
- Solved some errors when projectiles collides between them.
